# AI Project Instructions

This is the root context for AI agents operating in this repository.

Before making changes:

1. Load [AI system context](./ai/system.md).
2. Load [AI behavior rules](./ai/behavior.md).
3. Load [AI routing rules](./ai/routing.md).
4. Resolve affected paths and technologies with [routing metadata](./ai/routing.yaml).
5. Read every matched guideline before implementation.
6. Implement the smallest change that satisfies the request.
7. Run the required verification for the change type, or state why verification could not be run.

Do not proceed with implementation until guideline resolution is complete.
